colors.title: Colors
colors.intro: Pick a preset or any color. Every tint, line, hover and button in Hearth is worked out from these four, so one pick recolors the whole theme.
colors.accent_help: Buttons, links, the kettle and your own posts in Daytime.
colors.paper_help: The page in Daytime. Cards and lines are shaded from it. Keep it light; a dark color falls back to Oat so text stays readable.
colors.evening_accent_help: Buttons, the kettle and your own posts in Evening (dark mode).
colors.evening_ground_help: The page in Evening. Keep it dark; a light color falls back to Ember so text stays readable.
colors.invalid: That isn't a #RRGGBB color, so {fallback} is used.

settings.welcome_help: "Good afternoon, Mira" above the discussion list, with how many conversations have something new. Guests see your welcome title and message there instead of the banner. With Homecoming enabled, its welcome strip is used instead.
settings.own_right_label: Put each member's own posts on the right
settings.own_right_help: Like a chat. Turn it off to keep every post on the left.
settings.shelf_label: Show tags as a shelf of jars
settings.shelf_help: The Tags page shows each tag as a jar in its color, on wooden shelves. Off, it shows the usual tag tiles.
settings.seasons_help: A small sprig on the welcome card that changes with the season. They switch off by themselves while Festoon is enabled.
settings.house_rules_help: A few friendly lines shown on a card under the tags in the sidebar. Plain text; line breaks are kept. Leave it empty for no card. With FoF Forum Widgets you can place the card yourself.
